5.3. Vikāravyāvṛttaṃ prakṛter nityatvam, tac cātītānagatāvasthāśūnyatvam iti svarūpato dharmataś
ca nityānityobhayarūpatvaṃ prapañcasyeti pratipādayati tad etad iti / Tad etat trailolyaṃ
kāryakāraṇātmakaṃ caturviṃśatir tattvāni sakāryāṇīti yāvat, yathāyogyaṃ dharmarūpeṇa svataś ca
vyakter varttamānāvasthāto'paiti, nityatvapratiṣedhāt, naiveha kiñcanāgra, asad vā idam agra āsīt
ityādiśrutibhiḥ, vyaktāvyaktātmikā tasmin prakṛtiḥ saṃpralīyate ityādismṛtibhiḥ / Yat sāvayavaṃ tad
anityaṃ ghaṭādivad ityanumānenety arthaḥ /
